onsrud-2017.document: LMT Onsrud Production Cutting Tools Catalog 2017, pp.114-116
onsrud-2017.notes: per-tooth by series and diameter; SW/HW/MDF; HW chart covers ash beech birch cherry mahogany maple oak poplar teak walnut as one group; 68-100 PCD excluded (scope)

freud.document: Freud chip load chart, 4 diameters x 5 materials (research-session-1.md L41-46)
freud.machine_class_note: chart assumes a rigid 10+ hp industrial machine (session-1 practitioner evidence); Onsrud is the conservative floor

rennie.document: Rennie Tool chip load chart, 4 diameters x 4 materials (research-session-1.md L49-54); up OR down cut, NOT compression; 18000 rpm, DOC ~1xD
rennie.machine_class_note: chart assumes a rigid 10+ hp industrial machine (session-1 practitioner evidence); Onsrud is the conservative floor
rennie.notes: chart is for solid carbide up OR down cut spirals, NOT compression (per the chart itself); entries carry excludes_tool_types accordingly

vortex.document: Vortex Tool chart via Woodshop News / catalogue
vortex.machine_class_note: chart assumes a rigid 10+ hp industrial machine (session-1 practitioner evidence); Onsrud is the conservative floor
vortex.notes: superseded by vortex-chart, the firsthand read of the same chart

ita.flute_convention: total flutes reconciles published mm/tooth with 20 m/min @ 20k rpm reference point; upcut-only is the alternative reading - expose as user switch

onsrud-2017-ply.document: LMT Onsrud Production Cutting Tools Catalog 2017: Hard Plywood Cutting Data p.118 (research/sources/Hard Plywood.pdf) and Soft Plywood Cutting Data Recommendations (research/sources/Soft Plywood Cutting Data.pdf)
onsrud-2017-ply.notes: same series scope as the SW/HW/MDF extraction; hard plywood maps to material plywood, soft plywood to softwood_ply; the soft table publishes NO 52-200/57-200 spiral row; 37-xx, 40-50, 57-200MD, 60-090, 60-100DC/MC/PLR, 60-500 to 60-950, 64-000/65-000, 77-100 and 68-100 (PCD) out of the established scope

vortex-chart.document: Vortex Tool Company chip load chart, read firsthand (research/sources/vortex-chipLoadChart.pdf; the same chart prints on p.14 of research/sources/Vortex_Catalog.pdf)
vortex-chart.machine_class_note: chart assumes a rigid 10+ hp industrial machine (session-1 practitioner evidence); Onsrud is the conservative floor
vortex-chart.notes: The chart formula counts total flutes. The chart recommends 18,000 rpm for tools 3/8 in and smaller, and 16,000 rpm for larger tools. Softwood and plywood share one column, as do MDF and particleboard. The largest row is published as 1/2 in and up. The phenolic/paperstone column has no matching material and is not ingested. Supersedes the secondhand vortex source; the firsthand read confirms both of its values.

analysis_notes: Within-Onsrud spread by geometry, hardwood 12.7 mm: straight 48-000 0.152-0.203 vs compression chipbreaker 60-100C 0.533-0.584 (~3x). Tool geometry explains much of the session-1 vendor spread.
Onsrud 60-100C/60-300 tops sit at or above Vortex; conservative-Onsrud lore comes from their straight and plain-spiral series.
